name: AR_CASH_RECO_LINES_ALL
description: This table stores the line information of the recommendations on a receipt reference

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_ID
columns.description: Recommendation Identifier

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line Number

columns.name: PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Payment Schedule Identifier

columns.name: AMOUNT_APPLIED
columns.description: Amount Applied in Invoice Currency

columns.name: AMOUNT_APPLIED_FROM
columns.description: Amount Applied in the receipt currency

columns.name: TRANS_TO_RECEIPT_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate used to convert the transaction amount into the receipt currency.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_STATUS
columns.description: Recommendation Status

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_REASON
columns.description: Recommendation Reason

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Who column: indicates application that last updated this row. Foreign key to FND_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_ID.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Who column: indicates program that last updated this row. Foreign key to FND_CONCURRENT_PROGRAM.CONCURRENT_PROGRAM_ID.

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Concurrent program Who column.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CONS_INV_ID
columns.description: Balance Forward Bill Identifier

columns.name: RECEIPT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency Code of the receipt

columns.name: RECEIPT_DATE
columns.description: Receipt Date

columns.name: RECEIVABLES_TRX_ID
columns.description: Activity Identifier for the Over/Under Application recommendation

columns.name: MASTER_REQ_ID
columns.description: Request Identifier of the master autoapply/automatch program
